description: This file defines the 'PathValues' class, which encapsulates various path and package name configurations for a code generation session, based on XML pragma settings. It provides accessor methods for directory paths, package names, includes, and configuration flags related to Java and native code generation.

classes.name: PathValues
classes.description: Container class for storing path and package configuration details used during code generation based on XML pragma sections.

methods.name: PathValues
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a given ICPragma bean, extracting Java and Native configurations.

methods.name: getServiceDir
methods.description: Returns the base directory for generated service code.

methods.name: getServicePackage
methods.description: Returns the package name for generated service code.

methods.name: getApiDir
methods.description: Returns the base directory for generated API code.

methods.name: getApiPackage
methods.description: Returns the package name for generated API code.

methods.name: getEventDir
methods.description: Returns the base directory for generated event code.

methods.name: getEventPackage
methods.description: Returns the package name for generated event code.

methods.name: getNativeApiHeaderDir
methods.description: Returns the directory for native POJO, event, enum, and IPC header files, if configured.

methods.name: getNativeApiSrcDir
methods.description: Returns the directory for native POJO, event, and enum source files, if configured.

methods.name: isNativeApiDirsDefined
methods.description: Checks if native API header or source directories are defined.

methods.name: getNativeIpcHandlerDir
methods.description: Returns the directory for native IPC message handler source files.

methods.name: getNativeIncludes
methods.description: Returns the list of include directories or files for native code generation.

methods.name: getNativeFreeforms
methods.description: Returns additional freeform strings for native code generation.

methods.name: getNativeConfigFlag
methods.description: Returns the configuration flag string for native IPC setup.

methods.name: getJavaFreeforms
methods.description: Returns additional freeform strings for Java code generation.
